title:
From collection and analysis to the classroom,
connected in the Learning Loop
lead: When Lecognizer builds up learning data and finds anomaly signals, LearnHubble AI carries those signals into the decisions and actions of administrators, instructors, and learners.

loop.alt: Learning Loop: learner activity builds up in Lecognizer, Lecognizer AI finds signals, the Curriculum Administrator and the instructor decide and apply changes in LearnHubble AI, and the results flow back to learners in a continuous cycle

notes.desc: Collects and stores learning data using global standards. It links the data to competency frameworks based on 1EdTech CASE.
Identifies where many learners struggled to inform next semester’s learning design.
Administrators review AI alerts and raw data, then refine next semester’s CASE-based academic and job-related competency frameworks.
Instructors use AI alerts to plan additional lessons or support learners who need help.
Learners interact with AI when they need it, to keep learning effectively.

loop.caption: This semester’s learning data informs next semester’s learning design.

features.name: Lecognizer
features.text: A learning data repository built on global standards, with AI anomaly detection. Lecognizer collects and stores learning data from all teaching, learning, and operational activities in real time, together with its 1EdTech CASE curriculum context.
bullets: Real-time collection and storage using global standards, with learning data that carries over when systems change
Integrated dashboard and customizable charts, filtered queries and JSON/CSV downloads
Used in a national-level learning data hub and in AI platforms for offices of education and enterprises
features.alt: Example of the Lecognizer integrated dashboard screen

features.name: Lecognizer AI
features.text: An AI solution that analyzes learning data stored in Lecognizer. It finds and flags unusual patterns and where many learners struggled, and shows the raw data behind each alert.
bullets: Prioritizes signals that need attention and issues alerts
Shows the conditions behind each alert and the raw learning data in one flow
AI finds and analyzes, while administrators and instructors make the decisions
features.badge: 2 granted AI patents · Learning anomaly detection · Learner profiling
features.alt: Example of the Lecognizer AI anomaly detection screen: Statements stored in real time, and an anomaly signal in week 3 where pauses, rewinds, and wrong answers cluster in one section, with a likely cause

note: ※ Subjects, people, and figures on screen are demo data for product illustration.

items.name: Administrator
items.title: Refine the curriculum based on evidence
items.text: If an anomaly signal found by Lecognizer AI points to a curriculum-level issue, AI suggests a prerequisite link (CFAssociation) in the 1EdTech CASE framework. The administrator reviews the suggestion and applies it for the next semester.
points: Judging the level of issue behind an anomaly signal
A prerequisite link suggested as a CFAssociation (precedes)
Existing CFItems stay as they are, keeping last semester’s learning data

items.name: Instructor
items.title: Design a supplementary quiz where learners struggled
items.text: Shows where learners paused, rewound, and answered incorrectly, along with the evidence. When AI suggests a supplementary explanation and a check quiz, the instructor edits and applies them.
points: Sections that need attention, with evidence
The instructor decides whether to apply them

items.name: Learner
items.title: A check quiz appears automatically in the supplemented section
items.text: The supplementary explanation and check quiz the instructor applied appear automatically when learners reach that section, so they can recheck the difficult part on the spot. If they get stuck, AI offers a hint and lecture evidence instead of the answer.
points: Check quizzes that appear automatically in supplemented sections
Supplementary explanations applied by the instructor
AI hints and lecture evidence instead of answers
